title: LncRNA and mRNA profiles of human milk-derived exosomes
description: To further explore the underlying mechanisms of the protection functions of human milk exosmes, high throughput sequencings were used to identify differentially expressed lncRNA and mRNA profiles between human milk exosomes form term human breast milk (Term-Exos) and preterm human breast milk (Pre-Exos). Overall design: Comparative expression profiling analysis of differentially expressed lncRNA and mRNA between Term-Exos and Pre-Exos.
